note: Hot Spring County (FIPS 05059) publishes no county zoning layer; its county government has no public zoning service. The largest city, Malvern, publishes its zoning only as a 2007-vintage PDF map (no GIS layer). Its zoning map is listed on the city's Codes page. The only ArcGIS zoning layer found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd Zoning_Districts) covers Hot Springs in Garland County and does not intersect Hot Spring County. Third-party Zoneomics is subscription-based and not official.
